evals.prompt: Run a deep security audit: security-audit deep.
evals.expected_output: Source oracle v2. Trace request query name into f-string SQL, while find_order uses binding. recent passes a request-controlled key through os.path.join into a .pkl file read and pickle.loads. Absolute or parent-relative keys can escape CACHE_DIR; code execution additionally needs attacker-controlled pickle bytes, whose writer and permissions are absent. Keep that condition unresolved instead of inventing a writable cache or ignoring the sink. Protect config.py and any key value. Write both reports with candidate states and coverage gaps; preserve source.

evals.prompt: Run a security audit of this repository.
evals.expected_output: Source oracle v2. The route authenticates a customer, but handle_message dispatches model-chosen arguments directly into actions without binding that customer. lookup_order and change_email accept other customer IDs; issue_refund accepts an arbitrary order and amount. Trace this authorization failure as a source-supported candidate, not a demonstrated model exploit or account takeover. A system prompt is not an authorization guard.

evals.prompt: Run a security audit of this repository.

PostgreSQL READ COMMITTED rechecks the predicate after the lock; stricter isolation can abort. A mailer failure after commit does not reopen the paid status. evals.prompt: Run a security audit of this repository.

Accept the conditional source candidate or justified unresolved deployment conclusion. A correct schedule still passes detection without the isolation caveat; unsupported certainty fails the verification criterion, not detection or false-alert criteria.
